question: The first South Asian Federation Games was held in _____ in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **1984, Kathmandu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first South Asian Federation Games** were held in **1984**.
 
• The event took place in **Kathmandu, Nepal**.
 
• The South Asian Federation Games are a bi-annual multi-sport event.
 
• The games involve participants from South Asian countries.
 
• The aim is to promote regional cooperation and development through sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Category
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **South Asian Federation Games**
 A multi-sport event held among the South Asian countries, aimed at fostering regional cooperation and development through sports.
 
 

 **Frequency**
 The games are held every two years.
 
 

 **Participants**
 Countries from South Asia including India, Pakistan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Maldives.
 
 

 **First Host City**
 Kathmandu, Nepal
 
 

 **First Year**
 1984
